title: Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d)
description: Dein neuer Job Unsere Vision ist eine offene, nachhaltige und friedliche Gesellschaft, in der Gutes tun mit Wirkung das gemeinsame Handeln leitet. Um dazu unseren Beitrag zu leisten, haben wir PHINEO als gemeinnützige Plattform für strategisches gesellschaftliches Engagement aufgebaut. Gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen lassen sich heute nur gemeinsam lösen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Unternehmen, Stiftungen, Sozialunternehmen, öffentlichen Institutionen und zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen daran, sektorübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zu stärken und mehr Wirkung zu erzielen. Für unser Team in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Beratungs-, Netzwerk- und Gestaltungskompetenz miteinander verbindet, als Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d) . Deine Aufgaben Du bringst Akteur*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft, Philanthropie und öffentlichem Sektor gezielt zusammen, um Kooperationen mit gesellschaftlichem Impact anzuregen. Dafür entwickelst du neue Formen der sektorübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit. Parallel gestaltest und moderierst du etablierte Dialogformate im analogen und digitalen Raum. Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei IMPACT COLLECTIVES, unserem neuen Angebot, das Impact Startups mit Unternehmen, Investor*innen und weiteren Enablern aus Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und Zivilgesellschaft themenspezifisch verbinden wird und damit strukturellen Wandel entlang der großen gesellschaftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit vorantreibt. Du leitest unsere Corporate Citizenship Arbeitsgruppe , entwickelst sie strategisch weiter, gewinnst neue Unternehmen für die Mitwirkung. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit Vertreter*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft und öffentlicher Hand Impulse für eine wirksame gesellschaftliche Verantwortung von Unternehmen. Du konzipierst, akquirierst und verantwortest Beratungs- und Kooperationsprojekte. Beispielsweise berätst du Startups, die wissen möchten, wie sie mehr Impact erzielen oder Investor*innen finden können, oder begleitest Kooperationen zwischen Unternehmen und Nonprofits prozessual wie inhaltlich. Du steuerst komplexe Projekte eigenverantwortlich von der Konzeption über das Partnermanagement bis zur Umsetzung und Auswertung. Handlungsleitend sind für dich der angestrebte gesellschaftliche Mehrwert und eine wirtschaftliche Umsetzung. Bei der Arbeit bist du selbstverständlich nicht auf dich allein gestellt. Vielmehr bist du Teil eines engagierten Teams, das verschiedene Kompetenzen und Perspektiven vereint. Das bringst Du mit Du setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für gesellschaftliche Transformation, nachhaltiges Wirtschaften und die Zusammenarbeit von Akteur*innen aus unterschiedlichen gesellschaftlichen Bereichen ein. Du bringst die Energie, Überzeugungskraft und Empathie mit, die es braucht, um Vertrauen aufzubauen und Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu gewinnen. Auch skeptische Akteur*innen kannst du inspirieren und aktivieren. Du bringst Beratungserfahrung mit, idealerweise mit Startups, Investor*innen oder Unternehmen zu Fragen rund um Strategie oder Organisationentwicklung. Daher kannst du Beratungsprozesse konzipieren, eigenständig durchführen und zu belastbaren Ergebnissen führen. Du hast in der Vergangenheit bereits Netzwerke aufgebaut oder intensiv betreut, idealerweise mit Beteiligung von Akteuren aus der Wirtschaft und aus dem Startup-Bereich. Du kannst relevante Akteure zeitnah identifizieren und sie mit unseren Zielgruppen vernetzen. Du besitzt Erfahrungen mit Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen oder Collective-Impact-Ansätzen. Du bewegst dich sicher im Umgang mit Entscheider*innen auf Konzern- beziehungsweise Leitungsebene. Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Gewinnung von Partner*innen, Kund*innen oder Förder*innen sowie in der eigenverantwortlichen Leitung komplexer Projekte. Deine Vorteile bei uns Purpose Ein sinnstiftender Job mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Die Möglichkeit, an relevanten gesellschaftlichen Themen wie nachhaltige Wirtschaft, Stärkung von Demokratie und Klimaschutz mitzuarbeiten. Eine Organisation, die danach strebt, eine Vielfalt an Identitäten, Erfahrungshintergründen und Perspektiven zusammenzubringen. Ein großes Netzwerk an Kontakten aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Zivilgesellschaft. Konditionen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten 39 Stunden pro Woche in Vollzeit, Teilzeit bis zu 80% möglich. Die Befristung des Arbeitsvertrages (2 Jahre) ist ein Punkt, an dem wir noch einmal gemeinsam reflektieren und eine bewusste Entscheidung treffen – hoffentlich füreinander. Sie ist ein Standard in all unseren neuen Arbeitsverhältnissen, um Achtsamkeit und Bewusstsein auf beiden Seiten der Beziehung zu stärken. Diese Position liegt in unserer Stellengruppe 3 und ist beim aktuellen Aufgaben- und Verantwortungsspektrum bei einem Festgehalt zwischen 56.000 und 62.000 EUR verortet, abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation. Mehr Informationen zu unserem Gehaltssystem findest du auf unserer Website: https://www.phineo.org/jobs . Ein attraktiver Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und zum Jobticket, Fahrradprämie sowie Mitarbeitendenrabatte. Ein umfassendes Onboarding, mit strukturierter Einarbeitung. Interne und externe Weiterbildungsangebote. Arbeitszeitflexibilität und Familienfreundlichkeit 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr. Ein flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell mit Gleitzeitkonto. Die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten: sowohl regelmäßig im Inland als auch zwei Mal jährlich als Workation aus dem Ausland. Eine Kultur, in der die Vereinbarkeit mit dem Privatleben einen hohen Stellenwert hat. Wie wir in Kontakt kommen Klingt richtig gut? Dann bewirb dich mit deinen aussagekräftigen Unterlagen über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular. Wir sichten die Bewerbungen fortlaufend. Als Organisation, die gesellschaftliche Diversität erfolgreich mitgestalten will, freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Menschen mit anerkannter Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Da unsere Büroräume derzeit nicht komplett barrierefrei sind, gehen wir gern mit dir darüber ins Gespräch, was es braucht, um vorhandene Barrieren abzubauen. Wir bitten um dein Verständnis, dass wir ausschließlich Bewerbungen über unser Online-Formular berücksichtigen können. Bewerbungen per Post oder E-Mail können nicht verarbeitet und in unseren Bewerbungsprozess aufgenommen werden. Originalunterlagen werden nicht zurückgeschickt. Bei Fragen rund um die Anstellung bei PHINEO oder den Bewerbungsprozess wende dich bitte über Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget. 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. title: Praktikum Fundraising und Campaigning
description: Wir von GermanZero machen Deutschland klimaneutral – von unten. Als gemeinnütziger Verein treiben wir gemeinsam mit Hunderten ehrenamtlich Aktiven die Umsetzung von Klimaneutralität voran: Ort für Ort und auf Bundesebene. Mit unserem Netzwerk LocalZero unterstützen wir Städte und Gemeinden auf dem Weg zur Klimaneutralität. GermanZero ist spendenfinanziert. Die Organisation hat aktuell rund 40 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende und lebt vom bürgerschaftlichen Engagement mehrerer Hunderter ehrenamtlich Aktiven. Du möchtest gerne in die Fundraising-Abteilung einer gemeinnützigen Organisation reinschnuppern, hast Spaß daran, komplexe Themen rund um Klima und Politik zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten und hast Lust, die wichtigste Kampagnen-Saison mitzubegleiten? Super! Dann bewirb dich als Praktikant:in für unser Fundraising-Team mit dem Schwerpunkt Stiftungs- & Kleinspendenfundraising !  Wir suchen eine:n neue:n Praktikant:in ab 1. September oder 1. Oktober 2026. Mögliche Aufgaben:  Recherche von neuen Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen : Du identifizierst neue Trends sowie potenzielle Stiftungen, Aufrufe und Ausschreibungen, die zu unseren Projekten und strategischen Zielen passen, und erstellst Übersichten zu deren Förderkriterien und -schwerpunkten.  Kampagnen-Planung & Umsetzung: Du unterstützt bei der inhaltlichen und gestalterischen Umsetzung für Fundraising-Kampagnen, vom ersten Konzept bis zur Ausspielung über Mail oder Social-Media – insbesondere unsere Weihnachtskampagne  Mitwirkung an Kommunikationsmaßnahmen & Spendenaktionen : Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Quartalsupdates, Rundmails, Spendenmailings, Förder-Aufrufen und besonderen Aktionen, die unsere Unterstützer:innen und potenzielle Fördermittelgeber:innen erreichen.  Erstellen von Präsentationen und Projektvorstellungen : Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Gestaltung von überzeugenden Präsentationen, um Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen für unsere Projekte zu gewinnen.  Unterstützung bei der Redaktion von Anträgen : Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Förderanträgen, Zwischen- und Endberichten sowie der Dokumentation von Erfolgen und erzielter Wirkung.  Rundum-Blick in die digitalen Werkzeuge im Fundraising : Du erhältst Einblicke in die Nutzung von CRM-Systemen, KI-Tools & Datenbanken sowie Werkzeugen zur Projektsteuerung und zum Controlling großer Projektvorhaben.  Weitere Themen : Wenn du Lust hast, in weitere Fundraising-Themen reinzuschnuppern, hast du in unserem agilen Team jederzeit die Möglichkeit dazu. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen. Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Idealerweise suchen wir für diese Stelle eine Person, die in Berlin lebt und regelmäßig vor Ort sein kann. Wir suchen Praktikant:innen für einen Zeitraum von mindestens 3 Monaten mit 20-30 Stunden die Woche. Haben wir dich neugierig gemacht? Dann komm in unser Team und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns am Ziel, das Pariser Klimaversprechen einzuhalten und Deutschland mit konkreten Lösungen klimaneutral zu machen!   Bitte sende uns einen Lebenslauf und ein Anschreiben zu, aus dem deine Motivation deutlich wird. Du möchtest gerne in die Fundraising-Abteilung einer gemeinnützigen Organisation reinschnuppern, hast Spaß daran, komplexe Themen rund um Klima und Politik zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten und hast Lust, die wichtigste Kampagnen-Saison mitzubegleiten? Super! Dann bewirb dich als Praktikant:in für unser Fundraising-Team mit dem Schwerpunkt Stiftungs- & Kleinspendenfundraising! Wir suchen eine:n neue:n Praktikant:in ab 1. September oder 1. Oktober 2026.

Mögliche Aufgaben: 

  • Recherche von neuen Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen: Du identifizierst neue Trends sowie potenzielle Stiftungen, Aufrufe und Ausschreibungen, die zu unseren Projekten und strategischen Zielen passen, und erstellst Übersichten zu deren Förderkriterien und -schwerpunkten. 

  • Kampagnen-Planung & Umsetzung: Du unterstützt bei der inhaltlichen und gestalterischen Umsetzung für Fundraising-Kampagnen, vom ersten Konzept bis zur Ausspielung über Mail oder Social-Media – insbesondere unsere Weihnachtskampagne 

  • Mitwirkung an Kommunikationsmaßnahmen & Spendenaktionen: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Quartalsupdates, Rundmails, Spendenmailings, Förder-Aufrufen und besonderen Aktionen, die unsere Unterstützer:innen und potenzielle Fördermittelgeber:innen erreichen. 

  • Erstellen von Präsentationen und Projektvorstellungen: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Gestaltung von überzeugenden Präsentationen, um Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen für unsere Projekte zu gewinnen. 

  • Unterstützung bei der Redaktion von Anträgen: Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Förderanträgen, Zwischen- und Endberichten sowie der Dokumentation von Erfolgen und erzielter Wirkung. 

  • Rundum-Blick in die digitalen Werkzeuge im Fundraising: Du erhältst Einblicke in die Nutzung von CRM-Systemen, KI-Tools & Datenbanken sowie Werkzeugen zur Projektsteuerung und zum Controlling großer Projektvorhaben. 

  • Weitere Themen: Wenn du Lust hast, in weitere Fundraising-Themen reinzuschnuppern, hast du in unserem agilen Team jederzeit die Möglichkeit dazu. Wir erstellen einen umfassenden Praktikumsplan, der perfekt auf dich passt! 


  • Du bist kommunikationsfreudig, kannst gut zuhören und gehst offen auf andere Menschen zu.  

  • Du bist strukturiert und arbeitest selbstständig, erkennst aber auch deine Grenzen und scheust dich nicht, rechtzeitig nach Unterstützung oder Feedback zu fragen.  

  • Du bist sicher im Erstellen von Texten, hast ein gutes Auge fürs Detail und ein feines Gespür für ansprechende Kommunikation. 

  • Du bist eine gute Teamplayer:in, behältst deine Aufgaben gut im Blick und bringst Interesse an digitalen Tools und Software-Lösungen mit. 

  • Dir liegt der Klimaschutz am Herzen, und du möchtest andere Menschen für das Thema begeistern und gemeinsam etwas bewegen  

  • Du willst zeigen, wie wichtig das Engagement durch Spenden und Fördermittel für gemeinnützige Organisationen ist. 

Wichtig: Wir können aktuell leider nur Pflichtpraktika im Rahmen eines Studiums oder ein freiwilliges Engagement auf ehrenamtlicher Basis anbieten. Das Praktikum ist nicht vergütet. Wir arbeiten daran, zukünftig Praktikant:innen zumindest eine Aufwandsentschädigung bezahlen zu können. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen.

Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Idealerweise suchen wir für diese Stelle eine Person, die in Berlin lebt und regelmäßig vor Ort sein kann. Wir suchen Praktikant:innen für einen Zeitraum von mindestens 3 Monaten mit 20-30 Stunden die Woche.

Haben wir dich neugierig gemacht? Dann komm in unser Team und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns am Ziel, das Pariser Klimaversprechen einzuhalten und Deutschland mit konkreten Lösungen klimaneutral zu machen!  

Bitte sende uns einen Lebenslauf und ein Anschreiben zu, aus dem deine Motivation deutlich wird.

Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without giving up the quality standards that matter. We work with enterprise software companies, and we want to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem. This is a rare seat for someone early in their career / you will see how a company gets built and you will build a good part of it yourself. Learn how customers run their AI workloads, what those workloads cost and the quality standards they need. Set up the tools, CRM and processes we need to keep track of customers as the volume grows. Use AI throughout your own work so a team of our size can cover far more ground. Prepare materials for customers, investors and partners. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs). Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run. Your profile Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority. Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus! Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together. Langfristige Perspektive & Entwicklung: Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir einen klaren Fahrplan für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung – mit regelmäßigen Feedbacks und transparenten Zielen. Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob remote (innerhalb Deutschlands), hybrid oder im Berliner Office – wir ermöglichen Arbeitsmodelle, die sich mit deinem privaten und beruflichen Leben gut vereinbaren lassen. Entscheidungsfreiheit, Eigenverantwortung und klare Kommunikation gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu. Unterstützung und offene Arme: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. Eine Kultur von Challengern. Wir arbeiten ergebnisgetrieben, feiern Erfolge und erwarten, dass du uns challenged – und wir challengen zurück. Augenhöhe heißt bei uns: ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. Wer sich jetzt einbringt, baut sich ein Profil, das in der Branche selten ist. Benefits und Sweet Treats: Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren,180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Benefits

Send us your interest, CV, and a link to your GitHub or recent projects, or contact Simon Wilhelm directly.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. Your role

As Talent Acquisition Manager — Tech at bunch, you will own end-to-end hiring across Engineering, Product, Design and Analytics. You will build high-quality technical pipelines, translate business needs into structured hiring strategies, and partner with technical leaders to make sound, evidence-based hiring decisions.

You will:

  • Own assigned technical searches from kick-off through accepted offer and onboarding handover, turning role outcomes into clear scorecards, interview plans, sourcing strategies and delivery forecasts

  • Build targeted outbound pipelines, engage passive technical talent with relevant communication and develop reusable talent maps and relationships across referrals and technical communities

  • Partner with hiring managers on talent availability, location, compensation, level and search feasibility, while maintaining a high bar for interview quality, timely feedback and consistent assessment

  • Manage competing searches through explicit priorities, milestones, pipeline coverage and risk signals, keeping Ashby workflows, reporting and role-level forecasts accurate

  • Create a strong candidate experience and close effectively by understanding motivation, concerns and decision criteria early, then communicating clearly throughout the process

  • Use AI and automation to improve research, preparation, reporting and follow-up while retaining human judgment, data quality and accountability

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience in end-to-end recruitment, with meaningful ownership of technical roles in a fast-moving environment

  • A mix of agency and startup experience is a plus

  • You have hired for a diverse set of roles and seniorities within Engineering, Product, Design, and Data

  • You are intrinsically self-starting: you identify gaps, form a point of view, propose solutions and close loops without needing detailed direction

  • You are resilient and persistent when searches, stakeholders or candidates become difficult, while recognising when to change course

  • You are curious about technical work, talent markets and the business, and learn quickly enough to calibrate credibly with Engineering, Product and Analytics leaders

  • You are a creative sourcer who develops new talent pools, messages and routes to market when the standard process is not enough

  • You value structured kick-offs, scorecards, ATS discipline and data, but understand that process supports judgment rather than replacing it

  • You use recruiting data, AI and automation responsibly without outsourcing human judgment

What success looks like

  • Own it: Take end-to-end accountability for searches, candidate commitments and stakeholder follow-through. Surface risks early with a proposed solution and learn openly from mistakes.

  • Aim for impact: Focus on hiring work that moves the needle. Connect priorities to business and team outcomes, make explicit trade-offs and keep quality as part of speed.

  • Empower others: Invest time, empathy and recruiting expertise in candidates, hiring managers and teammates. Improve interview quality and help others make better decisions.

  • Always be curious: Ask why, challenge assumptions and continuously learn about technical roles, the talent market and bunch’s business. Turn each search into reusable insight.

  • Enjoy the ride: Bring warmth, authenticity and constructive energy to demanding work. Stay calm under pressure, recognise progress and help the team navigate setbacks together.

Workplace & benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid work with 3 days per week in the office in Mitte

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks per year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team interview with Roberto — 45 min: Motivation and the five values that matter most for operating in a fast-paced environment.

  2. Technical recruiting live case — 60 min: A conversational interview about real and situational recruiting decisions, stakeholder management, and team dynamics. No take-home assignment.

  3. Cross-functional round — 3 × 30 min: Conversations with an Engineering or Product Leaders, People Partner and People Lead.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale. You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation. You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together. In this role, you will:   Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes. Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure. Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.  Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact. Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud. Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements. Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization. Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for this role. 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production. Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes. Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language. Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred. Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure. Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience An ideal candidate also has: Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems. Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms. Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams. Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery. Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk. Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working  At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations  Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. raw.title: Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
raw.description:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation

  • Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup

  • Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx

  • Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library

  • Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes

  • Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets

  • Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use

What We're Looking For (ideally)

  • 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production

  • Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF

  • Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast

  • Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails

  • Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces

  • Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job systems around them

  • Practical experience putting LLM or agent calls into production systems: prompting, tool use, structured output, cost and latency control, and handling non-determinism

  • Understanding of what makes an asset physically valid in a simulator: visual versus collision geometry, mass properties, contact behavior, numerical stability

  • Judgment about quality bars, including when an asset is good enough and when it isn't

Nice to Have

  • Experience processing output from generative or reconstruction-based 3D sources, and evaluating that output automatically

  • Agent frameworks, orchestration and eval tooling applied to content generation

  • OpenUSD at scale: composition, layering, MaterialX

  • Semantic annotation and dataset curation at volume

  • Exposure to simulation stacks such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or similar

By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>ThinkRail is an innovative project within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. Its aim is to develop a declarative programming language tailored to AI-spec-driven development. Our goal is to build an infrastructure that enables the efficient creation of complex systems with AI, while maintaining the trust of users and flexibility in the results.</p> <p>Thinkrail (<a href="https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail">GitHub</a>, <a href="https://thinkrail.ai/blog/">Blog, </a><a href="https://thinkrail.ai">Website</a>) is now open source and in alpha, and we’re entering the next stage of the product’s development: initial market penetration. We’re focused on bringing it into real-world projects and turning it into a robust, production-ready system. To help us get there, we’re looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to join the team. You’d be joining at an early stage, with plenty of opportunity to influence the product as it continues to evolve.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence/Product Lead to work alongside the technical founder and own the product strategy for Thinkrail.</p> <p>This is not a traditional product management role. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.</p> <p>Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.</p> <p>You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <h3>Strategy &amp; Prioritization</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own your function's AI strategy,</strong> aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.</li> <li><strong>Map how work flows</strong> across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?</li> <li><strong>Manage intake</strong> of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.</li> <li><strong>Prioritize strategically</strong> against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.</li> </ul> <h3>Adoption &amp; Change Management</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Reimagine, not just automate.</strong> Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.</li> <li><strong>Drive adoption and change management</strong> together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.</li> <li><strong>Coordinate with Enterprise AI</strong> to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.</li> <li><strong>Build and bridge the Champion network in your function.</strong> Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On Building &amp; Agent Operations</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build AI agents</strong> using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.</li> <li><strong>Author and iterate on skills files</strong> that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.</li> <li><strong>Configure MCP servers and tools,</strong> giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.</li> <li><strong>Own your function's fleet of agents.</strong> Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.</li> <li><strong>Expect to rebuild.</strong> AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <h3>Business &amp; Strategic</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Deep knowledge of your function's operations.</strong> You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.</li> <li><strong>Strategic prioritization skills.</strong> You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>A product management mindset.</strong> You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.</li> <li><strong>Strong communication and influence.</strong> You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional instincts.</strong> You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Experience building peer networks or communities of practice.</strong> You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On &amp; Technical</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Comfortable building with AI tools.</strong> You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.</li> <li><strong>Ready to learn fast.</strong> Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.</li> <li><strong>Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities</strong> - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.</li> <li><strong>Ability to map data flows</strong> - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology &amp; AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

  • You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

  • You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

  • You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

  • You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

raw.title: Software Engineer (Future Hiring)
raw.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

This position will require reasonable travel to Saudi Arabia and/or Europe.&nbsp;</p> <p>Businesses that partner with Ocado come in all shapes and sizes, and leverage our technology in different ways.&nbsp; In this role, you will combine your knowledge of ecommerce, grocery retail, and online marketing with communication skills and analytical abilities to shape and influence how our partners grow online.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Partner Growth Manager will work with the Ocado Partner Account team to drive the growth agenda in our partner’s business, enabling our partners to improve commercial outcomes, grow their customer base, order volume, and overall profitability.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will build effective relationships with key commercial, marketing, and ecommerce stakeholders in our partners’ businesses. capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Languages: Fluency in English is essential. Leadership in a matrix environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>An extensive and proven track record in a senior transition, programme management, or project management role, gained within a large-scale media agency, consultancy, or other complex, global organization.</li> <li>Demonstrable success in leading complex, multi-market transitions for large, global clients or leading complex multi-market projects.</li> <li>Deep expertise in applying project, programme, and change management methodologies (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) to deliver successful business outcomes.</li> <li>Exceptional senior stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence and build consensus with executive-level leaders.</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing complex project budgets and ensuring profitability.</li> <li>Inspirational leadership skills with experience building and developing high-performing teams.</li> <li>A strategic and commercially-minded approach, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems with clarity and confidence.</li> <li>Familiarity with leveraging AI tools and AI-powered support for project management and project management tracking.</li> </ul> <p>Preferred Qualifications:</p> <ul> <li>Significant prior experience within an agency group active in multi-market environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.</p> <p>WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com</p> <p><strong>ABOUT WPP &amp; OPENDOOR</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built&nbsp;<strong>OpenDoor&nbsp;</strong>for<strong>&nbsp;Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong>&nbsp;is a unique integration&nbsp;of&nbsp;the best of&nbsp;WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions.&nbsp;Whether&nbsp;at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive&nbsp;<em>impact</em>&nbsp;– for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process.&nbsp;OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own&nbsp;<a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a>,&nbsp;and&nbsp;WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary.&nbsp;Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level&nbsp;customer&nbsp;centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor,&nbsp;not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients,&nbsp;but you&nbsp;are&nbsp;also&nbsp;taking a step to challenge&nbsp;yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Paid Social Account Manager. This is a Full-time position based in London. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best in class service for Amazon in every country across its diverse businesses, including XCM, Prime Video, and RMI.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p>Campaign Management</p> <ul> <li>Developing comprehensive paid social media plans (+ supporting material) that align with client’s objectives and KPIs. Able to clearly articulate the rationale for proposed campaign tactics (channels, budget, audience, formats etc.) and present these back, both to internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Responsible for end-to-end set up of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms (and working with junior team members to assist them with this task as necessary). Comfortable using advanced features such as bid rules and 3rd party optimisation/ creative/ measurement tools to achieve results for clients.</li> <li>Responsible for ensuring regular quality assurance (QA) checks are undertaken by everyone working on the account (both locally and in the Global Hub team) to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards.</li> <li>Responsible for monitoring campaign performance and pacing to ensure all activity delivers as expected. Troubleshooting and optimising campaigns in order to improve performance as necessary.</li> <li>Working with Executives, Snr. Executives and the Global Hub team to produce detailed &amp; accurate weekly/monthly campaign performance reports, often in Microsoft Excel. Leading client calls to present results as necessary.</li> <li>Writing performance commentary that delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients. Should be able to identify trends and recommend actions on-platform to capitalise/mitigate these trends as necessary. Working with junior team members to ensure standards for commentary remain consistent.</li> <li>Producing more detailed analysis including end-of-campaign reporting, quarterly/annual reviews, and for standalone projects.</li> </ul> <p>Client &amp; Partner Management</p> <ul> <li>Acting as a key social point-of-contact for your client(s) ensuring their continuing confidence in the quality of the team and agency’s social output.</li> <li>Demonstrating a deep understanding of the media and technology developments that influence your client’s business. Able to identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space, presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.</li> <li>Building and maintaining relationships with the key media partners including Meta, Twitter, Snap, TikTok, Pinterest and others.</li> </ul> <p>People Management</p> <ul> <li>Working with your line-manager to ensure the effective management of more junior team members ensuring workloads are sufficiently monitored &amp; prioritised to ensure deadlines are met.</li> <li>Able to communicate clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person. Leading presentations where necessary.</li> <li>Attend regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community. Leading by example to motivate and encourage those with less experience.</li> <li>Assisting with the recruitment process for the immediate and wider team. Attending interviews and acting as an ambassador for the team to potential candidates.</li> </ul> <p>Operational Excellence</p> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space. Presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing.</li> <li>Working with line-manager to develop and implement testing/learning agendas for clients that drive clear and actionable insight on each social platform.</li> <li>Working closely with planning team + other channel specialists to ensure paid social activity compliments and enhances the wider marketing mix.</li> <li>Responsible for accurate and timely fulfilment of mandatory agency finance processes. Working with junior team members and the Global Hub team to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment/invoicing and to minimise finance queries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP &amp; WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>The successful candidate should have experience working in a digital marketing or agency-based role and will need to demonstrate a track record of working with clients or external stakeholders.</li> <li>Extensive experience setting up and optimising paid social campaigns across a number of the key social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc). Training certifications in any of the key platforms would be a plus (e.g. Meta Blueprint).</li> <li>Experience planning large-scale paid social campaigns, preferably across a mix of brand and direct-response objectives.</li> </ul> <p>BONUS POINTS</p> <ul> <li>Experience compiling detailed and insightful end of campaign reports &amp; presentations. Knowledge of how to structure regular client review presentations (QBRs, annual reviews etc).</li> <li>Forming strong relationships is key to the role, the ideal candidate should feel comfortable presenting to clients and leading calls as required.</li> <li>Teamwork is key to this role and we are looking for someone who is collaborative, friendly, and with a can-do attitude.</li> <li>Some experience line managing individuals and/or helping to train others across paid social would be preferable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.<br><br>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Design and implement production-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners

  • Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes

  • Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts

Developer Platform

  • Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale

  • Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good

  • Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally

Reliability and scale

  • Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild

  • Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff

  • Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's

Technical leadership

  • Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows

  • Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects

  • Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration

  • 8+ years building production backend systems: APIs, data pipelines, distributed services at scale

  • Strong TypeScript backend experience

  • Direct ownership of a major project, start to finish, not just a contributor role on someone else's

  • A high-ownership background: startup, scale-up, or anywhere you couldn't hand the hard problems to someone else

  • Third-party integrations experience: ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs

  • Python/C++/Rust, alongside your TS work

  • Experience designing or contributing to developer-facing platforms or public APIs

  • Startup experience (~300 people or fewer), current or past. Doesn't need to be your most recent role

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

Location: Paris - the pay range for this role is €88,000–€120,000.

  • Variable pay based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets.

  • Hybrid flexibility. We're in the heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week.

  • Health insurance. Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers via Swile.

  • Annual offsite. The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs. Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

  1. Recruiter screen. 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager Interview. 45 min with your future manager. Your experience, your projects, your approach.

  3. Product Interview. 30 mins with the Product Manager for this team. We want to hear about how you've worked cross-functionally in previous roles.

  4. Technical assessment. 90 min. Code review exercise plus applied questions, including how you use AI in your workflow. Real problems, not tricks.
