title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program. In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems. The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations. Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated. Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics. Starting dates: Fall 2026 Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

3.      20-minute interview

4.      Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

•     Fluent English, written and spoken.

•     European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

•     Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

•     Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

•     Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits

•     A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

•     Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

•     All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

•     Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

raw.title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Full-time)
raw.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

  • Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
  • Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
  • Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
  • Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
  • Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1.      Application with a few short questions

2.      Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3.      20-minute interview

4.      Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5.      45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6.      Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

•     A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

•     Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

•     Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

•     Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

•     Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

•     Fluent English, written and spoken.

•     European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

•     Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

•     Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

•     Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

•     €1,250 - €1,750 per month (pro rata of €2,500 - €3,500 for 40H), depending on experience.

•     A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

•     Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

•     All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

•     Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. This is not a coffee-and-observe internship - you operate as part of the Finance team.

•     Start: As soon as possible, aiming for the beginning of October 2026

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

•     You own processes, not tickets: what you automate is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.

•     Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

•     Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.

•     International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

•     Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

•     Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

 

Join us to elevate our finance team to the next level!

title: Doctorant : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: Contexte : ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.   ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.   ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris) . Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans , inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.   ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne.  Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.   Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap , dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control” Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire. Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

·       Intérêt pour la modélisation numérique, la conception mécanique et l'électronique.

. Connaissances en physique/mathématiques/mécanique

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, recherche et innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.           

 

Au sein de la Direction Générale des Services (DGS), la Direction des Ressources Humaines (DRH) qui comprend 19 agents, est bilocalisée sur les sites de Palaiseau et Brest.

L’organisation actuelle est organisée autour de différents pôles :

  • un pôle pilotage des données RH

  • un pôle gestion et paie sur le campus de Paris-Saclay

  • un pôle gestion et paie sur le campus de Brest

  • un pôle recrutement et formation

  • un pôle action sociale

  • un pôle gestion des étudiants de Brest (notamment militaires)

 

Le poste de RRH du campus de Brest /Adjoint ou adjointe à la DRH, localisé à Brest, est hiérarchiquement rattaché à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines (localisée à Palaiseau).

Missions / Activités principales :

Le/la titulaire du poste est chargé/e des missions suivantes :

En tant qu’Adjoint/Adjointe DRH :

  • Contribuer, aux côtés de la Directrice RH, à la définition et à la mise en œuvre de la politique des ressources humaines de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des projets stratégiques, notamment sur les mesures d’harmonisation liées à un établissement multi-campus ;

  • Préparer et participer au comité RH 

  • Représenter la DRH dans les instances et réunions en tant que de besoin ;

  • Participer à l'harmonisation des politiques, processus RH et outils numériques (SIRH) de l'établissement en garantissant leur déploiement et mise en œuvre opérationnelle sur le site de Brest ;

 

En tant que responsable RH du campus de Brest :

  • Représenter la DRH sur le campus de Brest

  • Superviser le pôle Gestion administrative et paie (GA/paie), composé d’un responsable et de cinq gestionnaires

  • Superviser le pôle Gestion des dossiers administratifs des élèves ;

  • Assurer la responsabilité fonctionnelle, à l’échelle de l’établissement, des autres équipes de la DRH

  • Assurer le rôle de relais RH de proximité auprès des agents du campus de Brest ;

  • Assurer un rôle de conseil et d’accompagnement auprès des responsables hiérarchiques et des agents du campus de Brest en matière de ressources humaines ;

  • Contribuer, en lien avec le DGS, au maintien d’un dialogue social constructif sur le campus de Brest ;

  • Veiller à la bonne application des politiques et procédures RH et accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles liées à la fusion de l’établissement.

Missions / Activités annexes :

  • Participer à des groupes de travail internes ;

  • Concourir en tant que de besoin à toute activité contribuant à la politique RH de l’établissement dans son ensemble et aux activités du service en fonction des priorités définies ;

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement : définir et maintenir à jour les procédures RH dans une perspective d’amélioration continue et assurer leur conformité aux exigences légales et juridiques ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole.

Niveau de diplôme et formations :

  • Bac+ 4 minimum (diplôme en ressources humaines, droits public et social, …)

  • Expérience supérieure à 5 ans en tant que RRH

Emploi :

Postes ouverts aux candidats :

  • Fonctionnaire de catégorie A - Groupe RIFSEEP 2 (en détachement ou affectation pour une durée de 3 à 5 ans)

  • Agent contractuel (emploi pérenne ; CDD de 1 à 3 ans renouvelable) CDI possible après 2 ans de CDD

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : le 1er décembre 2026

Rémunération :

  • Fonctionnaires : selon les conditions statutaires (grille indiciaire, IFSE, CIA)

  • Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest : 2 rue François Verny 29806 Brest Cedex 9, avec des déplacements sur le campus Paris-Saclay (environ une fois par trimestre la première année)

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’École étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet - 39h par semaine (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager, au minimum à l’issue de la période d’essai)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 


Connaissances indispensables :

  • Connaissances juridiques en matière de ressources humaines

  • Connaissances approfondies des statuts de la fonction publique et de la gestion des fonctionnaires

  • Administration et gestion des personnels

Connaissances souhaitables :

  • Connaissance du milieu de l’enseignement supérieur et de la recherche

  • La connaissance de l’organisation du ministère des Armées serait un plus

Savoir-faire :

  • Management

  • Conduite et accompagnement du changement

  • Gestion des priorités

  • Analyse et synthèse

  • Management de projet

  • Utilisation des outils bureautique (Word, Excel) et des SIRH

  • Qualités rédactionnelles (rédaction de notes,...)

Aptitudes:

  • Disponibilité – Autonomie

  • Qualités relationnelles

  • Maitrise de soi et résistance au stress

  • Rigueur

  • Réactivité

Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). ENSTA supports the transformation of major national strategic sectors through its research, innovation and educational programmes, thereby addressing the challenges of national sovereignty. It comprises six teaching and research units (UFRs) which conduct applied research in close collaboration with industry. ENSTA is a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). As part of IP Paris, the school participates in the activities of IP Paris interdisciplinary centres, notably the Interdisciplinary Centre for Seas and Ocean (CIMO), co-founded with Ifremer and supported by the Defence Innovation Agency (AID) and the French research council CNRS. Researchers from the school also collaborate on studies led by interdisciplinary centres such as Hi-Paris – winner of the 2024 AI Cluster award – E4C and E4H, amongst others. Joining the school means becoming part of an institution committed to gender parity and professional equality, diversity and supporting its staff with disabilities, from the moment of recruitment and throughout their careers. To safeguard wellbeing at work, the school pursues an active policy on working conditions, based in particular on a healthy work-life balance. The AMRIT project :  Today in Europe, the operations of in situ observing platforms rely on a network of Research Infrastructures distributed all around Europe. The activities in the network include in situ and remote operations at sea and data management of a large number of assets for a wide variety of applications. Such activities rely on important IT resources, R&D to improve the capacity of the platforms, as well as managerial and financial activities to run the infrastructures and provide access to them. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) is a pioneering project designed to revolutionise the landscape of marine research infrastructures in Europe, strengthening their ability to respond to Europe's policy and global scientific challenges. AMRIT ( https://www.amritproject.eu/ ) is a Horizon Europe & UKRI funded project, with 26 European partners, designed to advance Marine Research Infrastructures (MRIs). By developing tools and services integrating the operations of marine observation platforms, AMRIT aims to:  Ensure seamless operation of marine observation platforms.  Ensure the full nominal use of sensors and accelerate their evolution.  Exploit the complementarity of the various observation platforms.  Ensure the overall coherence of the ocean data value chain.  Ensure a consistent and comprehensive list of metadata and descriptors. Mission of the Scientific and Technical Manager :  As third party of ARMINES, the administrative Coordinator of the Horizon Europe Project AMRIT, ENSTA is seeking a Scientific and Technical Manager. Under the supervision of the project Scientific Coordinator, Professor Laurent Mortier (ENSTA), the main tasks of the Project Manager are to: Coordinate the overall implementation of the project and monitor its progress, including work packages, deliverables, milestones, deadlines and key performance indicators, in close collaboration with the Scientific Coordinator and with the support of ARMINES administrative staff. Monitor project risks, deviations and corrective actions, and propose mitigation or adjustment measures where necessary. Lead and coordinate the consortium, maintaining regular communication with consortium members, facilitating collaboration among partners, ensuring the effective flow of information and supporting partners in the implementation of their activities. Organise and coordinate consortium meetings, including steering committee meetings, technical meetings and general assemblies, as well as their preparation and follow-up. Coordinate the preparation of project reports and deliverables, consolidating contributions from partners and ensuring their quality and timely submission. Contribute to the communication, dissemination and exploitation of project results, including through workshops and conferences, in coordination with the relevant partners. Act as the main liaison with the European Commission, including maintaining regular communication and follow-up with the Project Officer. Represent the consortium and build and maintain high-level relationships with key stakeholders at national, European and international levels. Required qualifications and skills : Applicants must have an advanced university degree (M.Sc or equivalent degree) in Oceanography, Marine Science or Engineering, or related fields. A PhD in a relevant field is an advantage. Applicants must have at least 5 years (PhD included) of relevant experience in ocean observations or services in ocean observation organisations. Applicants must have demonstrated experience in coordinating, managing and implementing projects, desirably at the European or international level. Excellent organizational, written and communication skills. Professional command of both spoken and written English, and good knowledge of French and/or another European language. Desired qualifications and skills : Motivation and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders on national, international (and interdisciplinary) levels including researchers, operators, administrative staff, science officers, and policy makers. Degree in management of European affairs or similar. Knowledge of major national and EU funding instruments. Experience of working and collaborating among Research Infrastructures in the environmental field. Working conditions : ENSTA is committed to a recruitment process that promotes equality, diversity and inclusion. All applications, regardless of any distinction (age, disability, gender, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, etc.), are welcome in our recruitment process. The role is full-time and involves travel within France and abroad, depending on the project’s requirements. Remote working is possible in accordance with the employer’s current policies. Administrative : The position is for a duration of 18 months, based in ENSTA premises in Brest, Brittany. Other locations may be considered. Please also send your CV, a covering letter, and the name of 2 referees in the project field, before 20th September 2026 to: Margot Provost ( ) and Pr. Laurent Mortier ( ) Interviews will be organised online with the shortlisted applicants. Complementary informations : The contract is financed by Grant Agreement 101132013 Horizon Europe - European Commission “Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together” (AMRIT) Connaissances : Connaissance des principaux instruments de financement nationaux et européens ; Expérience de travail et de collaboration au sein d’infrastructures de recherche dans le domaine de l’environnement. Savoir-faire:   Motivation et capacité à interagir avec de multiples parties prenantes aux niveaux national, international (et interdisciplinaire), notamment des chercheurs, des opérateurs, du personnel administratif, des responsables scientifiques ou équivalent ; Maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit, et bonne connaissance du français et / ou d’une autre langue européenne. Aptitudes:   Organisation ; Rédaction ; Communication. Être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau supérieur (Master ou équivalent) en océanographie, en sciences marines, en ingénierie ou dans les domaines connexes. Un doctorat dans le domaine pertinent constitue un atout. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux.

AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services informatiques. Il est coordonné scientifiquement par l’ENSTA. En développant des outils et des services pour la conduite des opérations des plateformes d’observation marine, AMRIT vise à :

  • Assurer un fonctionnement sans faille des plateformes d’observation marine.

  • Garantir la pleine utilisation nominale des capteurs et accélérer leur évolution.

  • Exploiter la complémentarité des différentes plateformes d’observation.

  • Assurer la cohérence globale de la chaîne de valeur des données océaniques.

  • Garantir une liste cohérente et exhaustive de métadonnées et de descripteurs.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Brest.

Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que coordinateur scientifique du projet AMRIT dans le cadre d’Horizon Europe, l’ENSTA recherche un responsable scientifique et technique.

Les principales missions du responsable de projet sont les suivantes :

  • Coordonner la mise en œuvre globale du projet et en suivre l’avancement, notamment les lots de travail, les livrables, les jalons, les échéances et les indicateurs clés de performance, en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur scientifique et avec le soutien du personnel administratif d’ARMINES ;

  • Suivre les risques liés au projet, les écarts et les actions correctives, et proposer des mesures d’atténuation ou d’ajustement si nécessaire ;

  • Diriger et coordonner le consortium, en maintenant une communication régulière avec ses membres, en facilitant la collaboration entre les partenaires, en assurant une circulation efficace de l’information et en accompagnant les partenaires dans la mise en œuvre de leurs activités ;

  • Organiser et coordonner les réunions du consortium, notamment les réunions du comité de pilotage, les réunions techniques et les assemblées générales, ainsi que leur préparation et leur suivi ;

  • Coordonner la préparation des rapports et des livrables du projet, en regroupant les contributions des partenaires et en garantissant leur qualité ainsi que leur remise dans les délais ;

  • Contribuer à la communication, à la diffusion et à l’exploitation des résultats du projet, notamment par le biais d’ateliers et de conférences, en coordination avec les partenaires concernés ;

  • Assurer la liaison principale avec la Commission européenne, notamment en maintenant.

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole.

Le poste est à temps plein et comprend des déplacements en France et à l’étranger en fonction des besoins du projet.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description: <p><strong>About Sezzle:</strong></p> <p>With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>:</p> <p>For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is <strong>&nbsp;$12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level </strong>per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience</p> <p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p class="p1">We are seeking an exceptional <strong>Principal Infrastructure Engineer</strong> to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.</p> <p class="p1">You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.</p> <p class="p1">Our stack runs on <strong>AWS</strong>, with workloads orchestrated on <strong>Kubernetes</strong> and data anchored in <strong>Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres)</strong>. You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.</p> <p class="p1">Operational ownership is part of the job. You will <strong>participate in the on-call rotation</strong> and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.</p> <p class="p1">You will also build and apply <strong>AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling</strong> for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.</p> <p class="p1">This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1"><strong>Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure</strong>: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Connect business understanding to improvements across the system</strong>: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Engineer for scale and performance</strong>: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Design and build AWS infrastructure</strong>: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and operate the Kubernetes platform</strong>: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres</strong>: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve reliability through engineering</strong>: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents</strong>: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Implement and test disaster recovery</strong>: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation</strong>: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build observability that makes production diagnosable</strong>: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deliver safe infrastructure migrations</strong>: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes</strong>: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling</strong>: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Make technical decisions clear and executable</strong>: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We look for:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li class="li1">Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)</li> <li class="li1"><strong>12+ years</strong> of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with AWS</strong>: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production</strong>: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with relational databases at scale</strong>, specifically <strong>RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres)</strong>: query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements</strong>: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Strong coding and automation skills</strong>, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Strong systems fundamentals</strong>: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.</li> <li class="li1">Experience operating a <strong>24/7, high-availability platform</strong> where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation</strong> and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.</li> <li class="li1">Experience implementing and testing <strong>disaster recovery</strong> against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.</li> <li class="li1">Practical experience with <strong>observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices</strong> for shared production infrastructure.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations</strong>, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.</li> <li class="li1">Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1">Experience in <strong>fintech, payments, or banking</strong>, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.</li> <li class="li1">Experience with <strong>multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing</strong>, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.</li> <li class="li1">Proficiency with <strong>Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo</strong>, or comparable observability systems.</li> <li class="li1">Experience building <strong>internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling</strong>, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.</li> <li class="li1">Experience building <strong>AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation</strong> with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points</li> <li>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You have relentlessly high standards</strong> - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.</li> <li><strong>You’re not bound by convention</strong> - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things</li> <li><strong>You need action</strong> - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.</li> <li><strong>You earn trust</strong> - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.</li> <li><strong>You have backbone; disagree, then commit </strong>- you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.</li> <li><strong>You deliver results </strong>- you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You go deep</strong>: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You build and ship</strong>: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You measure results</strong>: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You value simplicity</strong>: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You earn trust</strong>: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You stay accountable for the outcome</strong>: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sezzle’s Technology Stack:</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1"><strong>Languages:</strong> Golang, Python</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Database:</strong> MySQL, Postgres</li> <li class="li1"><strong>DevOps and Cloud:</strong> AWS, Kubernetes</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Version Control:</strong> Git</li> <li class="li1"><strong>CI/CD:</strong> Gitlab</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Open Source:</strong> Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. title: Staff Product Manager, Machine Learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.</p> <p>The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change.&nbsp;</p> <p>One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines.&nbsp;</p> <p>That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.</p> <p>Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.</p> <p>Join us to help us build a more resilient world together.&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>Role &amp; Team</strong></h2> <p>You’ll lead a core part of our Vegetation Intelligence, the product area that turns remote sensing imagery and data into the vegetation insights that utilities act on every day, through world-class machine learning models. It’s one of Overstory’s most foundational products, live with customers now, and it sits at the center of how we prevent outages and stop wildfires. Every missed tree is an outage or a fire that could have been prevented.</p> <p>The job is twofold. title: Senior Algorithm Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.</p></div><p>Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Machine Learning engineer!&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of Beacon's analytics and machine learning domain, you'll work alongside fellow data scientists, neuroscientists, engineers, and clinicians to scope, build, deploy, and maintain the machine and deep learning models that analyze brain and biosignal data for advancing sleep, neurological, and psychiatric therapy development.</p> <p>At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those who lead by example. As such, we're always seeking out new contributors whose work demonstrates innate curiosity, a bias toward simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and—most of all—a deep empathy toward colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.</p> <p>Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs in Boston, New York City and Paris. This is a primarily remote role for individuals based near Paris.</p> <p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Participate in and lead the entire biosignal-based algorithm development lifecycle for medical devices including specifications and requirements gathering, data curation and labeling, development, failure-analysis, production, maintenance, and documentation.</li> <li>Select, implement, and develop the most appropriate method for each problem, knowing when to apply deep learning techniques and when other methods are more effective.</li> <li>Enhance our internal deep learning and machine learning tools to boost team efficiency, introduce new model architectures and algorithmic techniques, and refine the codebase to encourage reusability where needed to enable rapid experimentation.</li> <li>Spread and improve our best practices to ensure algorithm implementations are user-friendly, well-documented, and thoroughly tested, including unit tests, comprehensive documentation, CI, and non-regression testing.</li> <li>Present results to key stakeholders and assist them in utilizing algorithms for client engagement.</li> <li>Support the client-facing projects to understand and shape the impact Beacon algorithms have for our customers, both for existing deployed algorithms, and future algorithm development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you will bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have more than 4 years of industry experience in machine learning and deep learning, particularly in health sciences or other regulated fields, with a proven track record of bringing algorithms into production.</li> <li>You are experienced with digital signal processing (DSP) and statistics and care about using the right tool for the job, which in many cases might not be machine learning or deep learning.</li> <li>You are proficient in using PyTorch (preferred) or other deep learning frameworks for training, developing, and deploying deep learning models.</li> <li>You are familiar with latest Deep Learning advances (Transformer/ViT, large scale modeling, large model training, ...)</li> <li>You follow and adopt best practices in software and ML engineering, including testing, version control, code reviews, documentation, Dockerization, CI/CD, and experiment tracking.</li> <li>You are familiar with biosignals, medical imaging data, or large time-series datasets, &nbsp;or are enthusiastic about learning more in the domain.</li> <li>You thrive in a team environment, recognizing that collaboration, open communication, and continuous feedback are essential for collective success.</li> <li>You are able to distill, discuss, and present complex technical topics in a way that is appropriate for the audience at hand, both internally and externally.</li> <li>You are excited to participate in the entire algorithm development lifecycle, which spans scoping, data wrangling, algorithm development/experimentation, formal validation, quality/regulatory documentation, production deployment, and working with clients who might benefit from these algorithms.</li> </ul> <div> <p>The base salary range for this role is determined based on past experience, specific skills and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.</p> <p>At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Dans ce rôle, vous portez la stratégie d'intégration des solutions IA (de l’automatisation des tâches ponctuelles à la vision Agentic), l'adoption et l'orchestration des transformations IA, en collaboration avec les Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Immergé chez le client, vous faites le lien entre les décideurs, les métiers et les équipes de delivery pour transformer le potentiel de l'IA en usages réels et mesurables.

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

Vos missions

Stratégie & cadrage

  • Construire la feuille de route IA d'un périmètre métier et la faire vivre

  • Qualifier et prioriser le portefeuille de cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et les risques

  • Concevoir les processus cibles intégrant l'IA et les agents, et définir les interactions entre l'humain et l'IA

  • Construire les business cases et les critères Go / No Go avec les décideurs

  • Identifier dès le cadrage les prérequis de sécurité, de gouvernance et de qualité des données

  • Éclairer les arbitrages entre produits existants et développements sur mesure (Make vs Buy)

Orchestration de la transformation

  • Dialoguer d'égal à égal avec le Delivery Manager sur l'avancement, les risques et les arbitrages priorité/délai/périmètre

  • Être en mesure d'assurer un pilotage projet de bout en bout sur des missions à faible volumétrie ne justifiant pas un Delivery Manager dédié

  • Aligner direction, métiers, IT et Data autour d'objectifs et d'un plan partagés

  • Séquencer les déploiements pour que chaque cas d'usage renforce le suivant

  • Planifier les déploiements, anticiper les dépendances et lever les blocages

  • Piloter le passage des pilotes à l'échelle avec les équipes de delivery ILLUIN

  • Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage (Coproj, Copil)

Adoption & conduite du changement

  • Concevoir la stratégie d'adoption (formation, communication, relais métiers, rituels)

  • Construire les plans de montée en compétences

  • Installer et animer des réseaux d'ambassadeurs IA chez le client

  • Identifier les résistances et mettre en place les réponses adaptées

Impact & mesure

  • Définir et suivre les KPIs d'adoption et d'impact (taux d'usage, temps gagné, qualité, économies opérationnelles)

  • Mesurer les résultats et les présenter aux décideurs en comitologie

  • Mettre en place les dispositifs de retours utilisateurs et d'amélioration continue

  • Ajuster la trajectoire de déploiement selon les signaux terrain

Vie du cabinet

  • Encadrer et faire progresser des consultants juniors en mission

  • Contribuer à la prospection commerciale, aux propositions et aux soutenances

  • Capitaliser les retours d'expérience et enrichir les méthodologies et playbooks du cabinet

Profil recherché : avant tout, vous êtes passionné(e) par l’IA et souhaitez contribuer pour la rendre véritablement utile pour les entreprises

Formation

  • Bac+5 école d'ingénieur, école de commerce ou université

  • Spécialisation ou formation complémentaire en Data / IA et/ou en conduite du changement fortement appréciée

Expérience

  • 3 à 7 ans d'expérience, dont 2 ans au moins sur des projets IA, data ou transformation numérique

  • Vous avez accompagné au moins 2 projets de déploiement IA de bout en bout, du cadrage à l'adoption

  • Vous avez déjà préparé et animé des instances de Project Management et de pilotage face à des décideurs

  • Expérience en contexte grands comptes ou cabinet de conseil est fortement appréciable

  • Anglais courant est un plus

Outils & compétences techniques

  • Fondamentaux IA (LLM, RAG, agents) suffisants pour évaluer une faisabilité et dialoguer avec les Data Scientists

  • Construction de business cases chiffrés et de grilles de priorisation

  • Construction et présentation de dashboards (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker)

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux data, gouvernance, sécurité et éthique IA

  • Compréhension générale des architectures cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Notions de gestion de projet (planning, jalons, gestion des risques, méthodes Agile) suffisantes pour dialoguer avec un Delivery Manager et, si besoin, piloter seul un projet de moindre envergure

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à embarquer des acteurs aux intérêts parfois divergents

  • Data storytelling, vous présentez des résultats chiffrés de façon convaincante aux décideurs

  • Capacité à naviguer l'ambiguïté des grandes organisations

  • Veille IA active, vous intégrez les évolutions du marché dans vos recommandations

  • Orientation résultats, vous cherchez l'impact avant la production de livrables

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Senior Software Engineer?

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

  • Understand and frame user and product problems, using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

  • Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad, from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, using monitoring, observability and data analysis tools to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

  • Design and evolve robust solutions, identifying performance, scalability and reliability opportunities and turning them into pragmatic technical improvements.

  • Bring strong expertise in at least one major part of our stack, while being able to join a new team and become autonomous on a high-impact initiative within a few weeks.

  • Improve engineering practices across the organization, through high-quality code reviews, pair programming, documentation, RFCs and the adoption of AI-assisted development without compromising software quality.

  • Act as a role model and a driver for other engineers, sharing knowledge, providing actionable feedback and helping the team continuously improve its technical skills and ways of working.

  • Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed, proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the Pennylane tech community, through technical content, onboarding, interviews, incident resolution, tech initiatives, meetups or other community-building activities.

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you…

  • Have strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and React (at least 7-8 years)

  • Combine technical expertise with strong product and business understanding, enjoy solving complex problems and care deeply about your users.

  • Are a collaborative team player, communicate clearly and take ownership of delivering reliable, pragmatic solutions.

  • Like being challenged and solving complex problems (accounting is complex in Europe)

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

 
 

🎁 What we offer

  • 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

  • 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 30 vacations days paid by Pennylane

  • 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

  • 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

  • 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

  • ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

  • 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

  • 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

  • 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

  1. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 13 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

  2. We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 
 

🤝Hiring process

  • You will first have a general chat with a Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

  • You’ll then have a test-home assignment + a debriefing session with two of our software engineers (1 hour)

  • You’ll have a last culture-fit discussion with two people from our tech leadership (1 h)

 

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

title: Product Manager (Protocol)
description: About Morpho Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . Location Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team). Role Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work. This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem. Responsibilities Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics. Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs. Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale. Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption. Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity. Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment. Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders. Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale. What Success Looks Like First 30 days You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers. First 3 months You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes. First 6 months You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process. Must Have Experience & Skills 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments. Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration. Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences. Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact. Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction. Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority. Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges. Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment. Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts. Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told. Team-first mindset, low ego. Nice to Have Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech. Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols. Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations. Perks & Benefits We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning. Equal Opportunity We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
